prompt: Nitrogen rule: an ODD molecular ion m/z (M⁺) tells you:

options.label: An odd number of nitrogens in the molecule
A halogen is present (Cl, Br, I give odd mass)
An oxygen is present (O-containing compounds have odd M+)

explanation: C, H, O, S, halogens all have even total mass contributions for normal valences. N (14, valence 3) breaks this symmetry: each N shifts parity by 1. Odd M⁺ → odd number of N (1, 3, 5…). Even M⁺ → 0 or even number of N.
